scope: Independent read-only source and failed-JUnit-artifact review of the bounded pt-BR crop consumer test lifecycle repair; no production/source edits or publication by this reviewer.
decision: Acceptable bounded test repair; exact-source Robolectric rerun still required.

failure_evidence.observed: The crop test failed at its full expected Portuguese validation message. Actual status was the English zero-selection preview; the exception suppressed an UnExecutedRunnablesException for queued main-loop work.

assessment: ImageCropDialog.kt:143-150 installs the custom validating Apply click listener inside setOnShowListener. The original test clicked without processing the queued show lifecycle; unchanged preview, no apply callback, and a still-showing dialog are consistent with the native pre-install listener queuing dismissal rather than executing validation.

Idling the main looper immediately after show() allows the production OnShow listener and initial posted preview work to complete before None/Apply interaction. The production validating listener then runs synchronously on performClick().
Idling after the native negative button accounts for queued native dismissal; asserting !isShowing adds lifecycle coverage.

The exact diff is additive: two imports, explanatory comment, two idle calls and one dismissal assertion. Every previous full-message, selection, no-apply and still-open-on-invalid assertion remains unchanged.

The saved supplementary Kotlin 1.9.24/API35 compile result has exit_code 0 and its changed-source SHA-256 matches this reviewed file. This is compile evidence only, against prebuilt dependency classes.
limitations: The queued-OnShow diagnosis is strongly supported by production source and the original failure artifact, but this reviewer has not executed the repaired test.
The failing run is evidence for the original source, not a runtime pass for this repair. Full exact-source Gradle/Robolectric and required CI results remain pending.
